rec: Teleport to Eagle's Peak. Fairy ring (AKQ), Necklace of passage (The Outpost [2]) (2)
rewards: Ability to use Eagle Transport System

st.t: Speak to Charlie in the Ardougne Zoo.
s: Ah, you sound like someone who needs a quest doing!
Sure. Any idea where I should start looking?

st.t: Go to the camp north of Eagles' Peak and search the pile of books for a Bird Book. The closest fairy ring is AKQ or teleport to The Outpost using the Necklace of Passage.
Tap the Bird Book in your inventory for a Metal Feather.
Climb the rocks next to the campsite (25 Agility), or follow the grey path south-east of the camp up the mountain. Use the Metal Feather on the Rocky Outcrop at the top.

i: Teleport to Eagle's Peak. Fairy ring (AKQ), Necklace of passage (The Outpost [2])

st.t: Enter Eagles' Peak through the Rocky Outcrop.

In the dungeon, go east to the Y-shaped junction, then south to the edge of the chasm where the giant feathers lie. Shout to Nickolaus across the chasm. If you can't, try to take a feather from the south-western pile and he will shout to you.
s: The Ardougne zookeeper sent me to find you.
Well if you gave me a ferret I could take it back for you.

st.t: Pick up 10 Eagle feathers from the piles in the main cavern.
Go speak to Asyff in south-east Varrock to have a disguise made.
s: Well, specifically I'm after a couple of bird costumes.

st.t: Speak to Asyff again.
s: I've got the feathers and materials you requested.
Okay, here are the materials. Eagle me up.

tr: Teleport to Eagle's Peak. Fairy ring (AKQ), Necklace of passage (The Outpost [2])

st.t: Enter the south-western cavern of Eagles' Peak.
Try to take the feather from the pedestal.
Use the winches in the corners of the room.
Take the feather from the pedestal.
Return to the main cavern.
Enter the north-western cavern of Eagles' Peak.
Inspect the Stone Pedestal here.
Inspect the rocks east of the pedestal.
Inspect the rocks north east of the last rock.
Inspect the opening north of the second rock.
Long-press the Kebbit that appears and choose Threaten. If the kebbit's gone, re-inspect the opening.
Pick up the silver feather. If it's despawned, inspect the opening to get it.
Return to the main cavern.
Enter the tunnel in the north east of the main cavern.
Collect 6 birdseed from the Birdseed holder.
Pull the lever west of the entrance down.
Use the odd bird seed on the Bird feeder in the far south eastern corner.
Use the odd bird seed on the bird feeder next to the one you just filled, just to its north-west.
Pull the lever in the south east corner down.
Push the lever west of the entrance up.
Put odd bird feed into the feeder in the south of the room, south of the lever you just pushed up and east of the south west lever.
Pull the lever in the south west corner down.
Go back to the lever west of the entrance and put odd bird feed into the feeder just north of it.
Pull the lever in the north west corner down.
Put odd bird feed into the feeder in the south west of the room
Put odd bird feed into the same feeder you filled just after pushing the lever west of the entrance back up.
Grab the Golden feather from the pedestal.
Return to the main cavern.
Use all three feathers on the large stone door with the eagle carving. From the south-west end of the main cavern take the path east: the door is just east of the tunnel to the bronze feather room.
Go through the feather door and sneak past the Eagle whilst wearing your eagle disguise.
Speak to Nickolaus.
Speak to Nickolaus in his camp north of Eagles' Peak.
s: Well I was originally sent to find you because of a ferret.

st.t: Bring the ferret back to Charlie in Ardougne Zoo.
